enabled.description: Globally enable or disable the Rygel UPnP media server.

interface.description: Network interface to bind Rygel to. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces.

device_name.description: Human-readable name for the device as it appears to UPnP clients.

min_port.description: Minimum TCP port number for media streaming connections.

max_port.description: Maximum TCP port number for media streaming connections.

media_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing media files to serve.

trash_dir.description: Optional directory where deleted/trashed items are stored. Leave empty to disable.

enable_transcoding.description: Enable or disable on-the-fly transcoding of unsupported media formats.

transcode_dir.description: Directory used to store temporary transcoded files.

enabled.description: Enable the MediaExport plugin to export local directories via UPnP.

uris.description: List of filesystem paths or URIs to export as media shares.

enabled.description: Enable integration with Tracker for metadata indexing.

metadata_extract.description: Extract metadata using Tracker before serving media.

plugins.description: Additional Rygel plugins to enable (beyond built-in defaults).

description.description: Optional human-readable description (used for comment in config).

items.description: Plugin option value (string, number, or boolean).
